notes:
No parent-supplied cache text. Full-text acquisition failed independently for both papers. DOI landing requests were inaccessible through web tool; publisher PDF/article requests returned 403/challenge and were not retried. Unpaywall and OpenAlex reported no open-access location for either DOI. Targeted title/DOI searches yielded metadata, abstracts and citations rather than either primary full text. Replication Southampton repository record explicitly has no associated downloadable files; Europe PMC PMID 10372472 reports no PMC full text or PDF. Abstract-only records were not accepted as full papers; no statistics or narrative verdict inferred. No requested target test was examined in full text.
Source follow-up: Fresh original-only blind validation. Supplied published article title/authors/year match the assigned reference. Visually inspected rendered PDF pp.7-10 (printed pp.743-746). PDF p.10 is entirely Figure 1, displaying both threat and happy bias scores for both anxiety groups at both exposure durations; it prints no F/t statistic or p value. Surrounding canonical text reports separate omnibus interactions, group effects for each face type, planned between-group contrasts at each duration, and within-group tests against zero. Description "Probe detection task." plus locator "p.10" does not choose among these tests. Accordingly no statistic or p was selected and target_match remains unknown. The available paper is not classified unavailable. Ancillary sample evidence, not promoted into a target-specific n field under the failure-side rule: printed p.743 (PDF p.7), Attentional Task, states "For the ® nal sam ple (n = 38), the mean percentage s of data lost". Rendered page confirms final sample n = 38; canonical-text glyphs and spacing preserved in this quote. Participants section (printed p.741) describes two participant exclusions, poor eyesight and outlying reaction times; Attentional Task describes error-trial removal, RT outlier removal below 250 or above 850 msec, and exclusion of a volunteer with 25% missing data. Canonical text uses spacing artifacts, ® for the fi ligature, and 3 for multiplication signs; rendered p.745 confirms multiplication signs in the ANOVAs, but none was normalized into a quotation. No secondary-source original values used. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
Source follow-up: N=38 follows the explicitly documented 40 tested minus two excluded, also supported by both groups’ printed sex ratios (19 each). Rendered PDF page 6 confirms interaction numerics. Published article copy from private Google Drive archive; DOI is not printed in the artifact front matter. Independent Crossref record matches exact requested title and author surname(s), year/issue and page range 595-604. PDF has10pages, complete main paper with methods/results and end references; model-reviewed first-page and final-substantive-page excerpts. First-page authors=Mogg,Bradley; title coverage=0.95. No shipped audit-value comparison.
